question: Can the validated full-component programs be replaced by only the exact component-output modes that the downstream L9H1/H4 task subspace can read, with the orthogonal weight complement causally secondary?

frozen_design.mlp_modes: For read map R, project donor-minus-live MLP output into orth(row(R)) in residual space.
frozen_design.attention_modes: For retained head h, project its raw pre-c_proj donor-minus-live output into orth(row(R W_O^h)).
frozen_design.no_fit: All projections derive only from frozen weights and task bases; no causal outcomes select ranks or directions.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_projection_g: Authorities, capabilities, orthogonal projectors, bank widths, record coverage, finiteness and exact price pass.
predictions.pred_b_weight_readable_modes_are_suffici: Readable-mode recovery is at least 0.80 of full-program recovery and donorward on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_c_weight_complements_are_secondary: Absolute complement recovery is at most 0.20 of full-program recovery on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_d_weight_modes_are_dimensionally_co: Every MLP projector rank is <=18 for has/had or <=3 for is/was, and every head projector rank is below raw head width 128.
predictions.pred_e_zero_causal_fit: No fitted scalar, backward pass, or model update.

decision: screen replaces full component patches by weight-readable modes in the next transparent program; null shows downstream readability alone is insufficient because nonlinear intermediate routing uses nominal complements; invalid on authority, capability, projection, gauge, coverage, finiteness, or price failure
